C1.worst_defect: Above the fold is clear (H1 'Point of sale for Vendure', a one-line explanation of Vendure, Live demo first), but below it the home page hands a newcomer server mechanics: the comparison table's refund row reads 'The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls', and 'Before you start' lists 'Node ^20.19 || >=22.12' and 'RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)'. A visitor who only half knows Vendure stops reading there.
C1.where: home.desktop.02 ('Live demo or your own store' table and 'Before you start'); home.phone.04-05

C2.worst_defect: The home page never says who makes VendurePOS. The only clue is the demo row 'All it sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com, with no cookie', which names another product's domain without explaining it, so a newcomer wonders whose analytics these are. The footer only says 'MIT licensed. Built with TallyUI. For Medusa, see MedusaPOS.'
C2.where: home.desktop.02 table row 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline'; footer

C3.worst_defect: Step 3 says 'Review the generated migration and include it in config.dbConnectionOptions.migrations (or your existing migration glob)' but gives no snippet for that edit. It is the one config change in the quick start without code; the code is only on Plugin setup, and for the bundled migrations, not the generated one.

C4.worst_defect: 'At the till' is the cashier page, linked from the home hero as 'For cashiers: At the till', yet it opens with a server-side error string ('This store's VendurePOS plugin is missing or out of date. Install or update it, then this till continues.') before any selling step. The leftover 'If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app' collapsible in Quick start step 5 also points at an old domain that a new reader has never seen.
C4.where: at-the-till.desktop.01 first paragraph; quick-start.desktop.03 / quick-start.phone.06 collapsible

C5.worst_defect: After the hero screenshot the home page is grey text: only two features get cards ('Keeps selling offline', 'Every sale lands once'), and the other eight are a plain two-column list with no icon or image, so the lower half looks unfinished next to the hero. Dark mode holds up.
C5.where: home.desktop.01 bottom to home.desktop.02 top; home.desktop-dark.jpg same region

C6.worst_defect: On phone the third hero action, 'For cashiers: At the till', drops to its own line under the two buttons and sits indented a few pixels further right than the text column. The top bar shows only 'Docs' and 'Live demo', with Quick start hidden behind the chevron.

C7.worst_defect: The share card crops the till screenshot through its first product row, cutting the stock badges and the cart's 'Order discount' button in half at the bottom edge, so the card's bottom edge looks cut off. Everything else is strong: Lighthouse 98/100/100/100 on home, a 404 status with a helpful page, llms.txt, sitemap and search all return 200.

overall_worst.defect: A first-time visitor cannot tell who is behind VendurePOS. No maker or team is named anywhere on the home page, and the only hint is an unexplained third-party-looking domain ('anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com') in the demo row. That makes trying the demo feel like being tracked by an unknown party.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 comparison table, last row; footer
overall_worst.fix: Name the maker in the footer, for example 'Made by the team behind WCPOS', and in that table cell say what ph.wcpos.com is: 'our own usage analytics (PostHog), run by WCPOS'.
